_comment: Optional. Copy to config/live.json and fill in to enable the ⚡ Live data button.
Without this file the app runs snapshot-only and the button is hidden.
These are tenant-specific resource identifiers, not secrets — no key or token belongs here.
The browser cannot call api.powerbi.com directly (CORS), so DAX goes through a
'fabric_proxy' Fabric User Data Function that forwards executeQueries server-side.
